Band-local spawns for band1_lower_meadows. `order` is this entry's index in the merged array and is the ONLY thing that decides merge position -- never file order, never band order. Existing entries keep the index they had before the split because encounter_director.gd seeds each cluster's scatter, level roll, IVs, traits and shiny draw from it (hash("wild_spawn_%d" % order)), so changing a number moves creatures and rerolls them. A new entry in this band takes an unused order in this band's reserved range 1000-1999, which no other band can collide with; do not renumber an existing one.

spawns._why_d1: BAND1-D1. Everything the pond hands off to south of z=552 was empty until this pass -- no wild, no gatherable, no prop, for the ~760m the spine runs before South Bridge -- and the 2026-08-21 owner playtest calls that exact stretch out by name ('pond-to-village travel feels long, bare and boring'). This is the first of three field clusters that break it up: a common species right beside the spine's own (-50,700) vertex, so the quiet resumes gradually rather than all 760m landing at once. Position checked against tools/_probe_band1_cadence.py -- lateral offset from the spine is ~35m, on-route by that probe's own 60m call.

BAND1-D1. Second corridor cluster, west of the spine as it swings out through (90,760)/(230,830) -- far enough from the pipwing cluster above that the two engage prompts do not contest each other, close enough that the stretch between them still reads as travelled ground rather than another dead interval. tools/_probe_band1_cadence.py: ~35m lateral.

BAND1-D1. Third corridor cluster, beside the spine's own eastward bulge through (360,910)/(430,1020) -- the last ordinary wild stop before the south_bridge_grunt checkpoint, so the run into the gate does not go quiet again after cluster 1003. tools/_probe_band1_cadence.py: ~30m lateral.

BAND1-D1 optional detour, coordinated with prompt 30's approved 'Meadowhart Herd' beat rather than inventing a separate quest. Deliberately OFF the spine (the route here runs (330,1130)-(180,1200)-(30,1250), swinging back toward South Bridge; the spine's own x at z=1230 is ~70) so finding the herd costs a real decision to leave the direct line to the bridge, not a glance sideways -- tools/_probe_band1_cadence.py measures the lateral offset at ~220m, clearly off-route rather than borderline. Meadowhart is otherwise unseen in Band 1 -- SH47 sited the band 2 herd just past the bridge for the rideable-in-stride fix, not as an early sighting -- so this is the only place in the band a player can lay eyes on (and, since it is wild and not trainer-owned, legally catch) the species the tournament final's mount and the saddle recipe already made them want. Same wild_band [2,6] as every other cluster in the file; nothing about being a detour makes it a different creature.
BAND1-D1-DENSITY. Owner directive 2026-08-22 (density comparison to Pokemon/Palworld/Valheim): route cluster at ~55m arc, 15m lateral, left side of the spine.
spawns._comment_stranded_p3_walk_clearance: STRANDED-P3, 2026-08-23. Same class of bug as data/config/bands/band3_the_river_lock/spawns.json's order 3037 (see that entry): the original centre/radius (z=35.2, r=14.2) reached to z=49.4 before wild_creature.gd's own 7.0m wander_radius (data/config/combat.json) was even added, and smoke_traversal.gd's basic four-direction walk near spawn happens to cross near z=40 on its move_left leg -- reproduced directly (tools/_probe_spawn_wedge.gd, the same frame-by-frame replay tools/_probe_mill_stall.gd used for the mill): the walk's own `get_slide_collision()` named `Wild_bramblebun_1006_3` as the collider, and on CI (run 2170) the contact was square-on long enough to trip the sustained-wedge check ('player got wedged ... at move_left at (-8, 40)') where a local run only grazed past it. Moved further out along z and the radius shrunk (35.2/14.2 -> 62.0/8.0) so even a full wander excursion (62-8-7=47) stays 7m clear of the walk's z~40 line, while keeping the same left-of-the-spine siting the density pass intended.

PW2 / prompt 62's 'at least one less-common/special temptation', and band1's only elder. SITE: a damp hollow west of the pond, found by tools/_probe_elder_site.gd rather than picked -- 0.83m of relief over 10m so the encounter arena forms on flat ground, 3.9m above the water line so it is not IN the pond, 96m from the pond centre (mosshell habitat: every other mosshell in band1 is pond-side) and 75m lateral from the nearest authored route. That last number is the point: tools/_probe_band1_cadence.py counts anything past 60m lateral as an optional detour rather than corridor cadence, so this is something a player finds by being curious about a low green hollow off the pond loop, not something the road walks them into. Prompt 30's rule that some optional content should be discoverable through curiosity rather than a quest giver, and its rule not to pre-label every secret, are why this gets no map landmark. DIFFERENTIATION: PW2 requires a behavioural distinction and says stats and scale cannot be the only one. `notice_range` 20 against the shared default of 9 means it stops and turns to watch the player from more than twice the usual distance -- and wild_creature.gd's own comment calls that stop-and-look 'the only cue the game gives that the creature is engageable', so this reads before combat starts, which is exactly PW2's readability rule. `wander_radius` 1.5 against 7 means it holds its ground instead of drifting: an old animal that owns this hollow. Both are existing configure() tunables, not new machinery. LEVEL: +4 on whatever band1's own curve rolls, not a pinned number -- an elder should stay relative to its region when chapter_curve.json moves. Against a post-tournament team that has just beaten a level 10-11 final, that is a real fight and not a wall, which is PW2's own 'keep early Band 1 encounters appropriately approachable'. CATCHABLE, deliberately: it is a wild, so the five-creature squeeze this creates is the whole temptation. Nothing on the wild path changes to make that true.
